name: ui-markdown
description: Rendered Markdown (GitHub/GitLab flavoured: tables, task lists, alerts, collapsible sections, table of contents), sanitised in the browser with the same rules as flaskspark.markdown; markdown.js renders and turns HTML back into Markdown (markdown-it, loaded on first use).

descriptions.--ui-markdown-heading-weight: Font weight of headings, table headers, titles.
descriptions.--ui-markdown-heading-border: Line below headings of level 1 and 2.
descriptions.--ui-markdown-code-bg: Background of code and code blocks.
descriptions.--ui-markdown-radius: Corner radius of code blocks, collapsible sections, the table of contents.
descriptions.--ui-markdown-table-border: Lines of tables, horizontal lines, collapsible sections.
